description.p: Your magic doesn't come from blood or elements. Somewhere — a rift, a dying star, a bargain, a birth under the wrong sky — the emptiness between worlds looked back at you, and left something behind. You don't cast fire or frost. You cast absence: raw force that pulls matter apart and unmakes what it touches.
As a Voidweaver, you control the realm between realms and can manipulate its power to shape the very battlefield.

When you cast a sorcerer spell that deals damage, you can change the damage type of that spell to force. For a spell with an instantaneous duration, this costs one use no matter how many separate damage rolls the spell makes. For a spell with a longer duration, it costs one use for each round on which the spell deals damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Additionally, when you damage a creature with a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to Unmake it further. The creature loses all temporary hit points and can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. This is separate from the use above and doesn't expend one.

sheet.description: When you cast a sorcerer spell that deals damage, you can change its damage type to force. When you damage a creature with a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point: the creature loses all temporary hit points and can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

description.p: You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Voidmancy Spells table. Each of these spells counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

tr.td: arms of Hadar, ray of sickness

sheet.description: You learn additional void spells at sorcerer levels 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. They count as sorcerer spells for you and don't count against your spells known.

description.p: You can manifest an aspect of the void's dreadful power. As a bonus action, you can spend 3 sorcery points to transform for 10 minutes. You gain the following benefits while transformed:

ul.li: You gain temporary hit points equal to 1d10 + your sorcerer level.
Whenever a creature takes force damage from one of your spells, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be moved 10 feet in any direction to a space you can see.
You have resistance to cold damage.
You are immune to the frightened condition.

sheet.description: You transform for 10 minutes. You gain {{void manifestation:temp hp}} temporary hit points, can move a creature 10 ft. in any direction whenever it takes force damage from you, have resistance to cold damage, and are immune to the frightened condition.

description.p: The void's power has a profound effect on your body and your magic. You no longer need to eat, drink, or breathe, and you have resistance to force damage.
When a creature is reduced to 0 hit points by your force damage, its body is Unmade: nothing remains, and it can't be restored to life by anything short of a true resurrection spell.

Once on each of your turns when this happens, you regain 1 sorcery point. You can regain sorcery points in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and you have resistance to force damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by your force damage is Unmade and can't be restored short of true resurrection. Once on each of your turns when this happens, you regain 1 sorcery point.

description.p: Your mastery over the void is complete, and you can rip open a gateway to the plane between planes. You can cast ravenous void without expending a spell slot. Once you do so, you can't cast it in this way again until you finish a long rest.

Any creature that dies to the effects of this spell is Unmade. When you cast it, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus to be immune to the spell's gravitational effects, as you shield them from the void's influence.

sheet.description: You can cast ravenous void without expending a spell slot. Creatures that die to it are Unmade. Choose up to {{proficiency}} creatures to be immune to its gravitational effects.
